study type: Case-control study, secondary analysis of data from the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network (MFMU) Cesarean Registry Database
cohort: Women with obesity (pre-pregnancy body mass index > 30 kg/m2) who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: In women with obesity who underwent cesarean delivery, increased risk of VTE was noted in those with endometritis, receiving a blood transfusion, having a coagulopathy, and urinary tract infection.
